import sys, tempfile, time, json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/Users/longwen/AndroidStudioProjects/skills/novel-ledger')
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'scripts'),str(ROOT/'tests')]
from novel_ledger import facts, workflow, understanding
from novel_ledger.evidence import evidence
from novel_ledger.contracts import digest, dump
from novel_ledger.sqlite_store import SQLiteRepository
from support import tracked_contract

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='novel-scale-qa-') as td:
        repo=SQLiteRepository.initialize(Path(td)/'book',workflow.new_book(tracked_contract(1667)))
        b=repo.load(); prev='genesis'; started=time.perf_counter()
        for n in range(1,1668):
            prose='第%d章：沈桐承担代价。'%n+'测'*3000
            event={'op':'character_development','entity':'shen','choice':'选择核实来源并继续调查。','cost':'承担调查后果并失去一次机会。','change':'改用证据判断人物的可信度。','evidence':{'chapter':n,'quote':'沈桐承担代价。'}}
            with repo.transaction():
                b['state'], normalized=facts.settle(b['state'],[event],prose,n)
                b['understanding']=understanding.update(b['understanding'],[{'id':'hero','kind':'character','claim':'沈桐对人的信任继续变化。','status':'supported','subjects':['shen'],'topics':[],'reason':'本章选择与代价。','evidence':[{'chapter':n,'quote':'沈桐承担代价。'}],'counterevidence':[]}],{n:prose},evidence,'fixture-'+str(n))
                row={'n':n,'title':'存储实验','prose':repo.document(prose),'events':repo.document(normalized),'plan':repo.document({}),'review':repo.document({}),'state_hash':digest(b['state']),'summary':'存储实验','han':3000}
                row['chain']=facts.chain(prev,row,digest(b['contract'])); repo.add_chapter('main',row);prev=row['chain']
                b.update(written_han=n*3000,revision=n)
                repo.save(b)
                # Every actual write task freezes these as complete_state/complete_understanding.
                state=repo.document(b['state']);memory=repo.document(b['understanding'])
                repo.add_task({'records':{'complete_state':state,'complete_understanding':memory},'stage':'storage-probe'})
                repo.db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET status='done' WHERE status='pending'")
            if n in (100,500,1000,1667):
                bytes_docs=repo.db.execute('SELECT sum(length(CAST(value AS BLOB))) FROM documents').fetchone()[0]
                print(json.dumps({'chapters':n,'prose_han':n*3000,'document_bytes':bytes_docs,'database_bytes':(Path(td)/'book/novel.sqlite3').stat().st_size,'current_state_bytes':len(dump(b['state']).encode()),'current_understanding_bytes':len(dump(b['understanding']).encode()),'elapsed_s':round(time.perf_counter()-started,3)},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        t=time.perf_counter();again=repo.load(); print(json.dumps({'reload_ms':round((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000,3),'latest_understandings':len(understanding.latest(again['understanding'])),'versions':len(again['understanding']['versions'])}),flush=True)
        repo.close()
main()
